# PrivaGlobe

> PrivaGlobe is a data privacy consultancy based in Mumbai, India. We provide consulting, implementation, documentation, audits, DPO as a Service and privacy software for India's DPDP Act, the EU and UK GDPR, US CCPA/CPRA, the PDPA of Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, and Saudi Arabia's PDPL. Contact: contact@privaglobe.com, +91 82668 99639.

Guidance pages show a "Last reviewed" date. Key DPDP dates: Rules notified 13 November 2025; consent manager framework starts 13 November 2026; main obligations and penalties apply from 13 May 2027.

## Privacy laws by region
- [DPDP Compliance Consultant in India](https://www.privaglobe.com/dpdp-compliance-consultant-india/): India's DPDP Act and Rules.
- [GDPR Consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/gdpr-consulting/): EU and UK GDPR.
- [CCPA and CPRA Consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/ccpa-cpra-compliance-consulting/): California consumer rights.
- [PDPA: Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand](https://www.privaglobe.com/pdpa-compliance-singapore-malaysia-thailand/): Three PDPAs compared.
- [Saudi PDPL Consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/saudi-pdpl-compliance-consulting/): SDAIA requirements and transfers.

- [DPDP Gap Assessment](https://www.privaglobe.com/dpdp-gap-assessment-india/): Scored gaps and a roadmap.

- [Data Breach Management](https://www.privaglobe.com/data-breach-management-dpdp/): Playbooks aligned to Rule 7.
- [DPO as a Service](https://www.privaglobe.com/dpo-as-a-service-india/): An outsourced Data Protection Officer.
- [ISO 27001 Consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/iso-27001-consulting-india/): We are not a certification body.
- [ISO 27701 Consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/iso-27701-privacy-information-management/): Privacy information management.

## Guides and resources
- [Data Privacy Resources](https://www.privaglobe.com/resources/): The hub for all guides.
- [DPDP Executive Guide](https://www.privaglobe.com/resources/dpdp-executive-guide/): A briefing for business leaders.
- [Free DPDP Readiness Check](https://www.privaglobe.com/assessment/): 12 questions, 5 minutes.
- [DPDP Readiness Checklist](https://www.privaglobe.com/resources/dpdp-readiness-checklist/): Eight areas to tick off.
- [DPDP vs GDPR](https://www.privaglobe.com/resources/dpdp-vs-gdpr/): Key differences.
- [Data Privacy Glossary](https://www.privaglobe.com/resources/data-privacy-glossary/): Plain-language definitions.
- [Blog](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/): Practical guides.
- [Do You Need a DPO Under DPDP?](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/do-you-need-a-dpo-under-dpdp/): Five-question decision path.
- [DPDP Rules 2025: What Organisations Need to Know](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/dpdp-rules-2025-what-organisations-need-to-know/): The DPDP Rules were notified on 13 November 2025. Here is what applies when, and what to do first.
- [How to Conduct a DPDP Gap Assessment](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/how-to-conduct-a-dpdp-gap-assessment/): A step-by-step method to find and rank your DPDP gaps before 13 May 2027.
- [Data Mapping: The First Step Towards DPDP Compliance](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/data-mapping-the-first-step-towards-dpdp-compliance/): Why every DPDP programme starts with knowing where personal data lives, and how to build a map that stays current.
- [Data Principal Rights: Organisational Responsibilities](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/data-principal-rights-organisational-responsibilities/): What the DPDP Act gives individuals and what your organisation has to build to honour it.
- [Consent Management Under the DPDP Act](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/consent-management-under-the-dpdp-act/): What valid DPDP consent looks like, how to record it and how to handle withdrawal.
- [Data Breach Management and Regulatory Responsibilities](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/data-breach-management-and-regulatory-responsibilities/): What Rule 7 expects after a personal data breach, and how to be ready in the first hour.
- [Privacy Risk Assessment: A Practical Guide](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/privacy-risk-assessment-a-practical-guide/): A simple, repeatable way to score privacy risk and decide when to run a full DPIA.
- [Vendor Risk Management and Data Protection](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/vendor-risk-management-and-data-protection/): Why you stay accountable for vendor data handling, and how to run a proportionate vendor programme.
- [Building a Sustainable Data Privacy Governance Framework](https://www.privaglobe.com/blog/building-a-sustainable-data-privacy-governance-framework/): Roles, policies, reviews and reporting that keep privacy compliance alive after the project ends.
